name: panol-demo
description: Demo funcional del Sistema de Pañol — monorepo raíz

scripts.demo: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "AUTH,INV,REQ,LOAN,AI,GW,WEB,TOT" -c "blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,red,white,gray" "npm run dev --prefix services/auth-svc" "npm run dev --prefix services/inventory-svc" "npm run dev --prefix services/request-svc" "npm run dev --prefix services/loan-svc" "npm run dev --prefix services/ai-assistant-svc" "npm run dev --prefix services/api-gateway" "npm run serve:web --prefix frontend/panol-frontend" "npm run serve:totem --prefix frontend/panol-frontend"
scripts.demo:backend: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "AUTH,INV,REQ,LOAN,AI,GW" -c "blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,red" "npm run dev --prefix services/auth-svc" "npm run dev --prefix services/inventory-svc" "npm run dev --prefix services/request-svc" "npm run dev --prefix services/loan-svc" "npm run dev --prefix services/ai-assistant-svc" "npm run dev --prefix services/api-gateway"
scripts.demo:frontend: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "WEB,TOT" -c "white,gray" "npm run serve:web --prefix frontend/panol-frontend" "npm run serve:totem --prefix frontend/panol-frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix services/auth-svc && npm install --prefix services/inventory-svc && npm install --prefix services/request-svc && npm install --prefix services/loan-svc && npm install --prefix services/ai-assistant-svc && npm install --prefix services/api-gateway && npm install --prefix frontend/panol-frontend
